اشتملا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَمَلَا (ištamalā) /iʃ.ta.ma.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# اُشْتُمِلَا (uštumilā) /uʃ.tu.mi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# اِشْتَمِلَا (ištamilā) /iʃ.ta.mi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
